Date: 2028-12-02T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: vendor VM cadence + CVE remediation evidence for SOC2 audit

Hi Soojin,

We're preparing for the SOC 2 vendor review next week and FinEdge's auditor has asked for consolidated vulnerability management evidence for all 3rd-party vendors that Redwood uses for inference (notably model hosting, telemetry, and S3/backups). Specifically they want:

- a scanned index showing most recent scans and cadence for the past 12 months (preferred CSV)
- documented SLAs for remediation windows for Critical/High CVEs and any exceptions or extensions in the period
- a CVE closure log with owner, dates opened/closed, and mitigation notes for each item referenced
- confirmation of signing authority and the contact who can attest to the evidence

Can you get a package to us by EOD Thursday 2028-12-04? Auditor name is FinEdge Audit < audit@finedge.com > if you need to send directly.

Thanks,
Asha
---
Asha Patel
Security Program Manager, FinEdge
asha@finedge.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@finedge.com>
Date: 2028-12-02T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: vendor VM cadence + CVE remediation evidence for SOC2 audit

Hi Asha,

Thanks — we'll assemble a concise package and get it to you by EOD on 12/04. High level notes we plan to include:

- scan index (CSV) with last 12 months of results for vendor-facing assets; cadence is weekly for infra and bi-weekly for vendor-managed endpoints
- CVE closure log (PDF) with ticket links and remediation notes; critical CVEs targeted to 7 days, high to 30 days unless exception documented
- exceptions log where we triaged to compensating controls (rare)
- our VM policy and vendor onboarding patch expectations (MD)

I'll upload everything to a shared Drive folder and share the link; please confirm whether the auditor wants encrypted attachments or a secure shared link.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
